title: Stalking
meaning: Repeated, unwanted following, watching, contacting or tracking that makes you afraid.
examples_and_warning_signs: Repeated calls or messages after you said stop
Someone tracking your location or social media
Turning up where you are without reason
steps: Tell a trusted adult. Do not handle it alone.
Keep a record of dates, places and messages.
Avoid going alone; change routes and routines if you can.
Tighten privacy settings and turn off location sharing.
Online stalking can be reported at cybercrime.gov.in.
seek_immediate_help: You are being followed now: go to a crowded place and call 112
